statement: The function returns a result r and r is the number of triples (x,y,z) of integers with 0 <= x,y,z < n such that pos1(x) < pos1(y) < pos1(z) and pos2(x) < pos2(y) < pos2(z), where pos1(v) denotes the unique index i with 0 <= i < n and nums1[i] = v, and pos2(v) denotes the unique index i with 0 <= i < n and nums2[i] = v. Equivalently, r is the number of 3-element subsets {x,y,z} of {0,...,n-1} whose elements occur in the same relative order in nums1 and nums2.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums1). Preconditions: len(nums2) = n; 3 <= n <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= nums1[i] < n and 0 <= nums2[i] < n; every value v with 0 <= v < n occurs exactly once in nums1 and exactly once in nums2 (equivalently, nums1 and nums2 are permutations of [0,1,...,n-1]).

statement: For every nums1 and nums2 satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result r (it does not fail, overflow, or panic).
preconditions: Let n = len(nums1). Preconditions: len(nums2) = n; 3 <= n <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= nums1[i] < n and 0 <= nums2[i] < n; every value v with 0 <= v < n occurs exactly once in nums1 and exactly once in nums2 (equivalently, nums1 and nums2 are permutations of [0,1,...,n-1]).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r for inputs satisfying the preconditions, r <= n*(n-1)*(n-2)/6, where n = len(nums1) and the right-hand side is computed over the integers (it equals C(n,3)).
preconditions: Let n = len(nums1). statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 0.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums1). Preconditions: len(nums2) = n; 3 <= n <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= nums1[i] < n and 0 <= nums2[i] < n; every value v with 0 <= v < n occurs exactly once in nums1 and exactly once in nums2 (equivalently, nums1 and nums2 are permutations of [0,1,...,n-1]); additionally nums2[i] = nums1[n-1-i] for every i with 0 <= i < n (nums2 is the reversal of nums1).

statement: For every pair of inputs (nums1,nums2) satisfying the preconditions, if the function returns r on (nums1,nums2) and returns r' on (nums2,nums1), then r = r'.
